filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) across 5 topics. For English, high-quality, high-reach videos were available for all topics. For Arabic, view count exceptions were used for two topics ('Ethical Dilemmas' and 'Networking Milestones') due to a lack of high-view candidates. For the 'Information Storage' topic in both languages, no single video covered both evolution and privacy well, so the selection prioritized the more complex privacy aspect.
